caption: Opening hours, where you service, do you take bookings on weekends. The same few questions land in your DMs again and again, and every one needs a reply. If those got answered for you, in your voice, how much of your week would you get back? Comment AGENT below.

slides.headline: What are your hours?
slides.body: Where do you service? Do you do weekends? You answer the same few questions on repeat.

slides.headline: Each one is quick to answer.
slides.body: But they pile up between jobs, on your phone, when your hands are full.

slides.headline: And the slow reply costs you.
slides.body: Someone who can't get a simple answer often moves on to the next business.

slides.headline: What if those answered themselves?
slides.body: The common questions handled instantly. In your voice. Day or night.

slides.headline: You only step in when it matters.
slides.body: Anything unusual or unsure gets handed straight back to you.
